title: Stack Update Consent
description: stack-update-consent/v1 (ADR-086 D15). Written by the model at <conf>/state/stack-consent/stack-update.json after a human answers yes to the D14 prompt. Deliberately writable by the model -- forgery is harmless by construction (D15): it can only cause the org's own, already-staged, pin-verified update to apply.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version tag. Always the literal string stack-update-consent/v1.

staged_sha.description: Full 40-hex. Must equal the receipt's staged_sha at apply time or the applier refuses (blocked/consent-stale).

granted_at.description: UTC. Must be within 900s (15 minutes) of the applier's read, or the applier refuses (blocked/consent-expired).

session_id.description: Must equal the applier hook payload's session_id, or the applier refuses (blocked/consent-stale).

door.description: Display only -- which of the two doors (D14) wrote this consent.
